messages:
ana: Idea: surface a 5-min on-demand "mini-webinar" modal on the pricing page that explains pricing rationale and unit economics. Use localized CTAs: US -> 'Try free', EU -> 'Request demo', APAC -> 'Start trial'. Keep it small and optional (dismissible).

chris: I like the modality. Suggest we A/B test with vs without the modal. Hypothesis: increased time-on-page and higher conversion from users who watch the video. Also reduces support questions about billing.

tariq: Dev constraints: modal assets should lazy-load. We'll need a feature flag `pricing_mini_webinar_v1` and a lightweight event path: `pricing_miniwebinar:open`, `pricing_miniwebinar:watch`, `pricing_miniwebinar:cta_click`. Can send to Amplitude/Segment.

emily: Copy note: the mini-webinar is 90s and should have 3 chapters: 1) why we price by usage, 2) quick example for a 10-seat startup, 3) upgrade path & SLAs. Also add a localized footer line about data residency for EU customers. I'll send drafts.

ana: @emily small correction: it's ana not nana :)

emily: oops sorry @ana :facepalm: fixed.

chris: For localization: we need CTA text + modal poster image per locale. Keep the naming scheme: cta_text_locale (e.g., cta_text_en-US, cta_text_en-GB, cta_text_zh-CN). Product-bot: can we reuse existing webinar sign-up flow for AE routing?

tariq: Routing rules proposal: if user submits interest AND estimated ARR >= $50k -> create lead in sales-inbound. If they watch >60s and click 'Talk to sales' -> ping AE channel. Else route to webinar-nurture list. We'll capture `estimated_arr` from the estimator widget when available.

emily: Also add an experiment arm where the modal includes an inline micro-estimator (seats x avg tokens) so users can see ballpark costs while watching. That might change behavior.

chris: Analytics: add goal funnel `pricing_page -> miniwebinar_open -> miniwebinar_watch60s -> miniwebinar_cta`. Baseline: measure baseline support tickets with subject contains "pricing" for 2w prior.

deploy-bot: Preview build deployed: https://preview.redwood/pricing-miniwebinar-4932109876 (feature flag: pricing_mini_webinar_v1). Visual + locale toggles included.

ana: Can we ensure GDPR consent banner won't block modal on first view in EU? Legal flagged that earlier.

emily: Good catch @ana. We'll show modal only after consent OR when user interacts with pricing. Alternative: defer to local cookie state. I'll update copy to have a one-line privacy callout and link.

chris: Dev checklist: 1) feature flag + rollout gating, 2) lazy-load video + poster per-locale, 3) event hooks to Segment/Amplitude, 4) lead routing integration, 5) A/B experiment key `pricing_miniwebinar_arm`.

tariq: ETA: 4 dev days if copy/design final. If we cut the inline estimator in v1, can do 2 days. Recommend soft-launch without estimator, then iterate.

ana: TL;DR: Launch plan: soft-launch Wed 09:00 PT behind flag (no inline estimator), run 10 days, monitor funnels & support volume, then decide on inline-estimator arm in week 2. Thanks team :raised_hands:
